body.message:
Last month, we agreed that my extension for August would be at the same rate of AED 5,500, and you confirmed that to me.

I was surprised to receive a different rate now after our agreement had already been confirmed.

At this point, I don’t have enough time to arrange another place for August, so I have no choice but to stay this month.

If the hotel has decided to change its pricing policy, I completely understand, but this should apply to future extensions after informing guests in advance, not to an extension that was already agreed upon.

Please honor our agreement for August at AED 5,500. If the rate will change for the following month, you can let me know in advance, and I will make other arrangements.

Thank you for your understanding.
